NAM.note: The document names an e-ID card pilot and an Identification and Authentication Act but states no authentication service.
No link between civil register and ID system is stated.
No count or share of people holding the ID is stated.
No number at birth is mentioned.
MPs asked about ownership and control where private providers are involved; the document states no operator or owner.
No public register keyed on the ID number is stated.

facts.fact: Home Affairs officials noted that Cabinet approved an e-ID pilot project in 2023 and that the Identification and Authentication Act of 2024 provides the legal framework; the ministries briefed MPs on the rollout of the new electronic ID card.
